input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term. Vendor warrants it has authority to enter the Agreement and grant the rights stated here.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets the preferred position on every material term. Vendor warrants Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel in accordance with industry standards (19.1), and that Services and Deliverables will materially conform to documentation and specifications. The conformance period is ninety days after delivery or acceptance (whichever is later) for Deliverables and the full subscription term for Hosted Services (19.2) — at or above the preferred 90-day services / 12-month software benchmark. Section 19.3 adds no-malicious-code and compliance with Applicable Law warranties. Section 19.4 supplies a real remedy ladder: prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, and termination plus refund of Fees paid if Vendor cannot cure in a reasonable period, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The disclaimer in 19.5 is mutual, limited to implied warranties, and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranty. Acceptance testing in Section 6 independently reinforces the refund path. No redline warranted.
